answers.core:
Bypassing `MultiMesh` via a custom RD solution also bypasses SDFGI, VoxelGI and the clustered forward renderer. `GPUParticles` already has this via `Texture2DRD` — this brings `MultiMesh` to parity. The `use_indirect` path (#99455) already established the pattern, this just extends it.

Edit: Thanks to @rschyboll for identifying the use_indirect gap and the LOD use case in the comments.
answers.workaround: No. Buffer binding happens at the native level. Workarounds are either GPU→GPU copies or redundant compute passes — neither acceptable at scale.
